slides.h: 12 said yes. 3 showed up. 1 was already there.
Tuesday: “Padel on Saturday at 6? Count me in.”
Ten minutes to get there. Forty to park.
The plan was at 7. The metro had other plans.
Nobody wants to pick the restaurant. Everybody has opinions about it.

slides.p: Saturday, 6:55 am: negotiating with the alarm.

slides.h: Types of people in every Delhi group chat
slides.p: You are at least one of these.
Books the court, makes the poll, sends the reminder. Thanked by nobody.
“I’ll let you know.” Has never let anyone know.
Replies two days later. “Sorry, just saw this.”
Currently, in fact, in the shower.
This is who we are building this for. Tag them.

slides.h: The one who orders for the table.

slides.p: Nobody may eat until the light is right.

slides.h: The one who is here for the coffee only.
slides.p: Has said “just a coffee” three times. Is eating your fries.

slides.h: The one who suggests splitting the bill equally.

lines: You said yes to padel on Tuesday.
Your bed is warm. Your alarm is rude.
The group chat finally picks a date.
